Medieval fantasy. Describe the region where the element Air (power of wind, storm and tempest) dominates. Be inspired by the following curtsies: Tibet (Buddhist culture), Maori people of New Zealand, Inca civilization of Peru.
Describe the region according to the following points:
- Name of the Region (proper name)
- Name of the Country (form of government and proper name)
- General description of the region and country
- Description of the Climate
- Description of the Relief and Landscape
- Description of Weather (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter)
- Description of Flora (specific types of terrestrial plants, trees, aquatic plants)
- Description of Fauna (specific types of animals, birds, fish, insects)
- Description of Monsters (specific types of wild monsters of land, air and water)
- Organization of government and state agencies
- Description of Culture, Traditions and Rituals.
- Description of clothing and fashion of noble people (men and women)
- Description of clothing and fashion of commoners (men and women)
- Description of clothing and fashion of clergy (men and women)
- Description of clothing and fashion of military (men and women)
- Architecture and organization of the city space (specific architectural techniques and elements)
- Architecture and organization of the village space (specific architectural techniques and elements)
- Architecture and organization of the castle space (specific architectural techniques and elements)
- Agriculture (specific cultivated plants and agricultural animals)
- Minerals
- Crafts and productions
- Cooking (specific dishes)
- Musical instruments
- Weapons, army and tactics
- History
- Example of male and female names
- Example of surnames
- Noble titles
